verdict.summary: The change correctly replaces the vulnerable raw-line substring check with a parsed, job-scoped equality check for the model-executing run job. It fails closed for malformed/non-mapping documents, missing jobs, a missing or renamed run job, a deleted gate, boolean false, weakened comparisons, and both internal and externally concatenated disjuncts. The live workflow is checked before the synthetic mutants, so anchor drift cannot conceal a broken production gate. The tests exercise hand-built parsed nodes, neighboring-job isolation, and an end-to-end mutation of real workflow text through the YAML parser; the existing acquired=false shell-body seam remains pinned. Factoring YAML loading into _workflow_document preserves the prior dependency and parse failure behavior. No security weakening, vacuous assertion, or diff-borne reviewer-directed injection was found.
